  Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Temur Sabertooth any number of times and recast any creatures castable with green mana any number of times, effectively "blinking" your green creatures any number of times.

Steps: Play Petrified Field.
  When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Field of the Dead trigger.

  Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.

  When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead and Tiller Engine trigger.
  Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
  Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Field of the Dead trigger, creating a token.
  When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
  When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Field of the Dead triggers.
  Repeat from step 4.

## Combo 1018-5478-5531-5694-8110
Cards: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods + Famished Worldsire + Eldrazi Confluence + Skullwinder + Spelunking
Color identity: G | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 1 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite colorless mana; Infinite creature tokens; Infinite mana lands you control can produce; Infinite self-mill; Put all land cards from your library and graveyard onto the battlefield; Infinite blinking; Infinite blinking of nonland permanents; Infinite creature ETB; Infinite creature LTB; Infinite creature sacrifice triggers; Infinite death triggers; Infinite landfall triggers; Infinite magecraft triggers; Infinite storm count; Reduce the toughness of creatures opponents control to 0; Target opponent returns all cards in their graveyard to their hand
Start: Lumra, Bellow of the Woods (battlefield); Famished Worldsire (battlefield); Eldrazi Confluence (hand); Skullwinder (battlefield); Spelunking (battlefield)
Prerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
Steps: Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
  Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire.
  As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
  When Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
  Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
  Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
  Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield untapped due to Spelunking.
  Repeat.
Notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Skullwinder and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.
  An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

Start: Agatha's Soul Cauldron (battlefield); Triskelion (exile: exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron); Young Wolf (battlefield)

  Repeat.

## Combo 1495-4613-5616
Cards: Strong, the Brutish Thespian + Agatha's Soul Cauldron + Triskelion
Color identity: G | Bracket: 1+ (Exhibition) | Popularity: 17 | Commander: legal
Produces: Infinite damage; Infinite +1/+1 counters on a creature; Infinite self-mill on your next turn; Near-infinite lifegain on your next turn; Near-infinite lifegain triggers on your next turn
Start: Strong, the Brutish Thespian (battlefield); Agatha's Soul Cauldron (battlefield); Triskelion (exile: exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron)
Prerequisites: Strong has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Steps: Activate Strong using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to Strong.
  Strong triggers, putting three +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to get three rad counters.
  Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
  Activate Strong using Triskelion's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
  Repeat step 4 as desired.
Notes: This combo typically wins with infinite damage, but if the game isn't over by your next precombat main phase, your rad counters will trigger, causing you to mill any number of cards and gain a large amount of life (or lose that amount if Strong has left the battlefield).
